title: MSG Rangers and Huron Consulting Group Set to Join S&P SmallCap 600
summary: S&P Dow Jones Indices will make the following changes to the S&P SmallCap 600: MSG Rangers Inc. (NYSE: MSGR) will be added to the S&P SmallCap 600 effective prior to the opening of trading on...
body_markdown:
NEW YORK


, Oct. 22, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- S&P Dow Jones Indices will make the following changes to the S&P SmallCap 600:


- MSG Rangers Inc. (NYSE: MSGR) will be added to the S&P SmallCap 600 effective prior to the opening of trading on Tuesday, October 27, replacing Arbor Realty Trust (NYSE: ABR), which will be removed from the S&P SmallCap 600 effective prior to the opening of trading on Wednesday, October 28. S&P SmallCap 600 constituent Madison Square Garden Sports Corp. (NYSE: MSGS) is spinning off MSG Rangers in a transaction expected to be completed on October 27. Madison Square Garden Sports will be renamed MSG Knickerbockers Inc. (NYSE: MSGK) and will remain in the S&P SmallCap 600. Arbor Realty Trust is no longer representative of the small-cap market space.
- Huron Consulting Group Inc. (NASD: HURN) will replace Supernus Pharmaceuticals Inc. (NASD: SUPN) in the S&P SmallCap 600 effective prior to the opening of trading on Monday, November 2. Indivior Pharmaceuticals Inc. (NASD: INDV) is acquiring Supernus Pharmaceuticals in a deal expected to be completed soon, pending final closing conditions.
